newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Livestock analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 356,000 to 365,000 head versus 358,000 a week ago and 360,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 35,000 to 45,000 head versus 43,000 a week ago and 170,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 127,000 to 129,000 head versus 132,000 a week ago and 127,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 25,000 to 32,000 head versus 28,000 a week ago and 22,000 a year ago.
